---
id: html-02
title: "Label a form field"
minutes: 5
tier: core
---

## Ask

Show two ways to give a text input an accessible name.

## Look for

### junior

- Uses a `label` with `for`, or wraps the input in one
- Says a placeholder is not a label

### mid

- Names `aria-labelledby` as a fallback, and when it fits
- Checks the name in the accessibility pane #communication

## Follow-ups

- How would you check the name in devtools?
- What about a group of radio buttons?
